name: Vernonia

project_scope.selection_mode: B089 hybrid anchor + B141 strict-parent handoff
project_scope.note: Canonical learner currently contains the natural hybrid Vernonia × guadalupensis. Parent species have older local-occurrence-first core packages but still require independent strict 3-target-county review.

priority: intermediate characters in the natural hybrid
study_strategy.warning: Do not force intermediate plants into either parent. Vernonia × guadalupensis is an accepted natural hybrid between V. baldwinii and V. lindheimeri; mature flowering material and nearby parent populations are important.

quick_comparison: V. baldwinii — broader rougher leaves and broad terminal clusters; strict target-zone review still pending.
V. lindheimeri — narrower leaves, typically woollier beneath and adapted to dry rocky sites; strict target-zone review still pending.
V. × guadalupensis — intermediate leaf width/hairiness and other traits where the parent concepts meet; canonical PASS hybrid.
